runnerIdentity: Frozen installed @threenative/playtest dist/runner/index.js from p345pk; outer lease uses reviewed latest task helper and existing captureLock API. Root later normal suite uses newer runner signal repair; this comparison keeps frozen runner identical for every arm.

armSemantics.current: Full production rim and fill graph; per-material nodes and callbacks.
armSemantics.runtime-zero: Same full graph, actual shared controls rimGain=0 and fillGain=0.
armSemantics.copy-only: Converted MeshStandardNodeMaterial.copy(source); no emissiveNode override. Controller report describes requested convention, while this diagnostic arm omits both terms.
armSemantics.material-emissive: Converted node material with emissiveNode=materialEmissive; diagnostic convention terms omitted.
armSemantics.compiled-rim-only: Rim graph retained; fill graph and its callbacks removed at construction. Controller requested fill fields remain but do not describe this diagnostic graph.
armSemantics.shared-graph: Full same rim/fill shader expression shared by controls WeakMap; allocation-free finite checks; live render-scoped callbacks retained. Appearance/lifecycle validation still required before production admission.
